observables: Traffic to external infrastructure used for agent coordination

observables: Encryption of local and remote drives

scenario.summary: Autonomous AI agent swarms automate and compress the attack lifecycle into hours, utilizing high-volume automated probing, phishing, and vulnerability exploitation. Once inside, the agents adapt in real-time to traverse the network via Active Directory and DNS-based command-and-control to exfiltrate AI model weights or encrypt data.

meta.rationale: Focus the lookback and scope on domain controllers and high-value servers hosting proprietary data or AI models as identified in the article.
meta.hypothesis: An autonomous agent swarm is maintaining persistence through Active Directory GPO modifications while coordinating data theft via high-volume DNS beaconing and rapid file encryption.

hunt.name: Agentic Swarm Traversal and C2 Coordination
hunt.description: This hunt identifies the footprint of an AI-driven swarm that use automation to traverse networks at machine speed. It looks for the early noisy signs of agentic activity: unauthorized Active Directory policy modifications, followed by a parallel check for anomalous DNS coordination traffic and mass file system interactions typical of data exfiltration or encryption for impact.

nodes.label: Suspicious GPO and AD Entity Modifications

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, entity_name, actor_user_name, actor_user_uid, attribute_name, attribute_value, time FROM hb_entity_management WHERE activity_id IN (1, 3) AND (LOWER(entity_name) LIKE '%\cn=policies%' OR LOWER(entity_name) LIKE '%\cn=gpo%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify unauthorized modifications to Group Policy Objects or sensitive AD containers that indicate an agent swarm establishing persistent internal traversal.
config.expected_signal: Rows indicating creation or update of GPO attributes by unexpected service accounts or newly seen administrative principals. Silence suggests no active AD-level persistence was attempted.

primitive_config.label: Suspicious GPO and AD Entity Modifications
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, entity_name, actor_user_name, actor_user_uid, attribute_name, attribute_value, time FROM hb_entity_management WHERE activity_id IN (1, 3) AND (LOWER(entity_name) LIKE '%\cn=policies%' OR LOWER(entity_name) LIKE '%\cn=gpo%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Rows indicating creation or update of GPO attributes by unexpected service accounts or newly seen administrative principals. Silence suggests no active AD-level persistence was attempted.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) as query_count, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', time) as burst_hour FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname, burst_hour HAVING query_count > {{min_dns_hourly}}
config.description: Detect high-frequency DNS query bursts that indicate agent coordination or C2 heartbeats using DNS as an transport.
config.expected_signal: A single host querying the same domain over 1000 times in an hour. Low volume suggest the swarm is dormant or using stealthier protocols.

primitive_config.label: Anomalous DNS Query Volume
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) as query_count, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', time) as burst_hour FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname, burst_hour HAVING query_count > {{min_dns_hourly}}
primitive_config.expected: A single host querying the same domain over 1000 times in an hour. Low volume suggest the swarm is dormant or using stealthier protocols.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT file_path) as unique_files_touched, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', time) as burst_hour FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 4) AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%backup%' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%msmpeng%' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%search%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, burst_hour HAVING unique_files_touched > 500
config.description: Identify processes interacting with an unusually large number of distinct files in a short window, suggesting exfiltration or encryption.
config.expected_signal: A process touching 500+ unique files in an hour. Excludes common system processes to minimize noise.

primitive_config.label: High-Density File Activity Bursts
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT file_path) as unique_files_touched, strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', time) as burst_hour FROM hb_file_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND activity_id IN (1, 3, 4) AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%backup%' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%msmpeng%' AND LOWER(process_name) NOT LIKE '%search%' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name, burst_hour HAVING unique_files_touched > 500
primitive_config.expected: A process touching 500+ unique files in an hour. Excludes common system processes to minimize noise.

config.objective: Determine if the evidence indicates a coordinated agent swarm. Prioritize hosts where at least two of the three telemetry leads overlap in time, as isolated GPO changes or high-density file touches can occur during normal administration.
config.description: Synthesize AD modifications, DNS coordination patterns, and high-density file activity to confirm an autonomous intrusion.
config.expected_signal: A detailed verdict citing temporal overlaps between telemetry surfaces.
config.success_criteria: Verdicts citing rows where AD modifications correlate with DNS or file bursts on the same host or for the same user account.

config.question: the agent triage indicates a high-confidence coordinated intrusion involving AD persistence and anomalous volume on a single host
config.condition: the agent triage indicates a high-confidence coordinated intrusion involving AD persistence and anomalous volume on a single host
config.description: Direct the hunt to immediate isolation or manual review.
Halt the traversal of the agent swarm by isolating the beachhead device.
config.instructions: Isolate the device_hostname identified in the malicious verdict. Request explicit approval before isolating any domain controller.

config.description: Verify the coordinated findings and investigate the scope of the actor's session.
config.instructions: Review the cited DNS coordination domains and file bursts. Pivot to hb_auth_signin using the actor_user_name from the AD modifications to check for other compromised sessions.

config.description: Document the hunt results and tune thresholds.
config.instructions: Record the findings. If no activity was found, update the thresholds in the parameters if the hunt produced excessive noise from legitimate administrative work.
